notes: The source page (URL ending 'all-automotive-systems-cert-fall-2025') is for the All Automotive Systems Certificate, not the A.S. Degree requested. It prints only 'All Automotive Systems Certificate (Total 48)' with 'Complete all of the following' AUTO100, AUTO160, AUTO211, AUTO220, AUTO230, AUTO240, AUTO250, AUTO260, AUTO270, AUTO280. No A.S. degree requirements, GE pattern or degree total appear, so no blocks were recorded for the A.S. award. A reviewer should locate the A.S. Degree page.

The Program Goals and Objectives section of the certificate page names entry-level jobs: apprentice mechanic, assistant technician, mechanic's helper, predelivery technician, installer, service technician, service attendant, smog technician trainee. These were not recorded because they belong to the certificate's section, though they may apply to the degree as well.

The Program Outcomes section, headed 'All Automotive Systems Cert', is cut off mid-word: '1. Analyze and evaluate critical aspects of the automotive industry related t'. It belongs to the certificate and is incomplete, so no outcomes were recorded.
The page's description says students need a grade of 'C' or better in all required core courses 'to qualify for the degree or certificate', which suggests a related degree exists.
The page also contains internal curriculum-workflow text (Checklist, Workflow Agreement), which was ignored.
